  order: 4

<!-- Generated by make site-ref (scripts/sitegen) from wdx itself: do not edit. -->

A failure carries a stable `code`. Text output ends its error line with it, as `wdx: ... [not_found]`; with `--json`, stdout holds Problem Details with the same `code` (see [JSON output](/wdx/docs/reference/json/)). The exit code says what kind of failure it was: 1 rejected, 2 usage, 3 a system failure.

## aca_unavailable

The AI coding agent is not installed or is disabled, or none is installed and enabled.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx agent create`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-create), [`wdx agent models`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-models), [`wdx agent restart`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-restart), [`wdx agent start`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-start)

## aca_unsupported

The agent's AI coding agent cannot do this yet.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx agent restart`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-restart), [`wdx agent transcript`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-transcript)

## agent_busy

The agent is in the middle of something, which this would lose.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx agent restart`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-restart), [`wdx agent start`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-start)

## agent_not_running

The agent's AI coding agent is not running.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx agent attach`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-attach), [`wdx agent send`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-send), [`wdx message resend`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/message/#wdx-message-resend)

## agent_removed

The agent was removed and stays only for its children.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx agent create`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-create), [`wdx agent remove`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-remove), [`wdx agent rename`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-rename), [`wdx agent restart`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-restart), [`wdx agent send`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-send), [`wdx agent start`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-start)

## agent_running

The agent is already starting or running.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx agent remove`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-remove), [`wdx agent start`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-start)

## agent_working

An agent is working in the worktree.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx plan task done`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/plan/#wdx-plan-task-done), [`wdx plan task land`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/plan/#wdx-plan-task-land), [`wdx worktree land`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/worktree/#wdx-worktree-land), [`wdx worktree rebase`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/worktree/#wdx-worktree-rebase)

## already_running

A daemon already serves this home.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx daemon start`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/daemon/#wdx-daemon-start)

## attach_unsupported

The terminal was started by a wdx too old to attach to.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx agent attach`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-attach), [`wdx terminal attach`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/terminal/#wdx-terminal-attach)

## base_moved

The base moved during the check.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx worktree land`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/worktree/#wdx-worktree-land)

## base_not_pulled

The PR below is merged on GitHub, but not in the local default branch.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx worktree rebase`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/worktree/#wdx-worktree-rebase)

## branch_exists

A new worktree's branch already exists.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx agent create`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-create), [`wdx plan run`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/plan/#wdx-plan-run)

## cancelled

The question was answered no.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx deps install`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/deps/#wdx-deps-install), [`wdx doc remove`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/doc/#wdx-doc-remove), [`wdx plan cancel`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/plan/#wdx-plan-cancel), [`wdx plan remove`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/plan/#wdx-plan-remove), [`wdx project open`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/project/#wdx-project-open)

## check_failed

The project's check failed.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx worktree land`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/worktree/#wdx-worktree-land)

## checkout_missing

None of the project's checkouts is left on disk.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx doc sync-to-git`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/doc/#wdx-doc-sync-to-git), [`wdx project create`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/project/#wdx-project-create), [`wdx project open`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/project/#wdx-project-open)

## checksum_mismatch

The downloaded release does not match its checksum.

Exit 3 · HTTP 502 · returned by [`wdx update`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/update/)

## clone_failed

Git clone failed.

Exit 1 · HTTP 502 · returned by [`wdx project create`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/project/#wdx-project-create), [`wdx project open`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/project/#wdx-project-open)

## connection_lost

The connection to the terminal ended before its shell did.

Exit 3 · HTTP 503 · returned by [`wdx agent attach`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/#wdx-agent-attach), [`wdx terminal attach`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/terminal/#wdx-terminal-attach)

A program the request needs is not installed: wdx deps list tells which.

Exit 3 · HTTP 503 · returned by [`wdx project create`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/project/#wdx-project-create), [`wdx project get`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/project/#wdx-project-get), [`wdx project open`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/project/#wdx-project-open), [`wdx worktree land`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/worktree/#wdx-worktree-land), [`wdx worktree rebase`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/worktree/#wdx-worktree-rebase)

## detached_head

The worktree is on no branch, so a PR has none to push.

## doc_changed

The doc has a newer revision than the base given.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx doc update`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/doc/#wdx-doc-update)

## download_failed

The release could not be found or downloaded.

Exit 3 · HTTP 502 · returned by [`wdx update`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/update/)

## editor_running

An editor has the file, or a file in the directory, open.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409

## fast_forward_failed

Git would not move the base forward.

Exit 1 · HTTP 409 · returned by [`wdx worktree land`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/worktree/#wdx-worktree-land)

## install_failed

The package manager failed.

Exit 3 · HTTP 502 · returned by [`wdx deps install`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/deps/#wdx-deps-install)
